dct_description_sm: All available bathymetry and related information for Blood Indian Creek Reservoir were collected and hard copy maps digitized where necessary. The data were validated against more recent data (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission 'SRTM' imagery and Indian Remote Sensing 'IRS' imagery) and corrected where necessary. The published data set contains the lake bathymetry formatted as an Arc ascii grid. Bathymetric contours and the boundary polygon are available as shapefiles.
dct_title_s: Blood Indian Creek Reservoir, Alberta - Bathymetry, Digital Elevation Model (Arc ASCII grid format)
